That is correct when running a package (`python -m foo.bar` gives spec name `foo.bar.__main__`, parent `foo.bar`), but wrong when running a dotted module (`python -m foo.bar.baz` gives spec name `foo.bar.baz`, parent `foo.bar`), so the last component is dropped. The fix should use the spec's full `name` unless it ends in `.__main__`, in which case `parent` is still correct.
